descriptions.TOTALPOP: Total population allocated from Census blocks to grid cells.
descriptions.AUND1: Population younger than one year, combining the male and female source counts.
descriptions.A1TO4: Population ages 1 through 4, combining the male and female source counts.
descriptions.A5TO17: Population ages 5 through 17, combining the male and female source counts.
descriptions.A18TO24: Population ages 18 through 24, combining the male and female source counts.
descriptions.AUND25: Population younger than age 25. This grouping overlaps the individual age groups below 25.
descriptions.A25OV: Population age 25 and older, combining the male and female source counts.
descriptions.A25TO64: Population ages 25 through 64, combining the male and female source counts.
descriptions.A65TO79: Population ages 65 through 79, combining the male and female source counts.
descriptions.A80OV: Population age 80 and older, combining the male and female source counts.
descriptions.WOMCHILD: Female population ages 15 through 49. This variable does not count children or identify mothers.
descriptions.WHITE: Population reporting White alone, regardless of Hispanic or Latino origin.
descriptions.BLACK: Population reporting Black or African American alone, regardless of Hispanic or Latino origin. Distinct from NHISPBLACK.
descriptions.AMIND: Population reporting American Indian and Alaska Native alone, regardless of Hispanic or Latino origin.
descriptions.ASIAN: Population reporting Asian alone, regardless of Hispanic or Latino origin.
descriptions.HAWPI: Population reporting Native Hawaiian and Other Pacific Islander alone, regardless of Hispanic or Latino origin.
descriptions.OTHER: Population reporting Some Other Race alone, regardless of Hispanic or Latino origin.
descriptions.TWOMORE: Population reporting two or more races, regardless of Hispanic or Latino origin.
descriptions.NHISP: Population not of Hispanic or Latino origin, of any race.
descriptions.HISP: Population of Hispanic or Latino origin, of any race. Hispanic origin is separate from race.
descriptions.NHISPWHITE: Population not of Hispanic or Latino origin who report White alone.
descriptions.NHISPBLACK: Population not of Hispanic or Latino origin who report Black or African American alone. A subset of BLACK, rather than a replacement for it.
descriptions.HOUSEHOLD: Total households. This is a household count, distinct from the number of people in occupied housing units and from the total number of housing units.
descriptions.HHPOP: Population living in occupied housing units. Counts people, rather than households or housing units.
descriptions.HHUNIT: Total housing units, including occupied and vacant units. Distinct from HOUSEHOLD.
descriptions.OCC: Occupied housing units, using the corrected occupied-unit source expression. Household and occupied-unit counts represent the corresponding household/occupied-unit identity.
descriptions.OWN: Owner-occupied housing units, a subset of occupied housing units.
descriptions.VACANT: Vacant housing units. The retained source expression is equivalent to the corresponding vacant-unit total.
descriptions.HU1P: Occupied housing units with one person, combining the owner-occupied and renter-occupied source categories.
descriptions.PIXEL_LAND: Land area of block/grid intersections, summed by grid-cell identifier after water subtraction and nonnegative clipping. Expressed in km² per cell, not a population count or density.
descriptions.PIXEL_WATER: Water area of block/grid intersections, summed by grid-cell identifier. Expressed in km² per cell, not a population count or density.
